en.title: Letter-writing supplies
en.objective: Recognize the Japanese words for a pencil, paper, a postage stamp, a letter, an envelope and a ballpoint pen used when writing or mailing a letter.

id.title: Perlengkapan menulis surat
id.objective: Kenali kata bahasa Jepang untuk pensil, kertas, prangko, surat, amplop, dan bolpoin yang digunakan saat menulis atau mengirim surat.

groups.levelRationale: All six entries have an exact ent_seq match in the pinned Yomitan N5 CSV. JMdict establishes lexical forms and senses, not JLPT level. N5 placement is an editorial decision for common concrete objects; priority tags support commonness without proving JLPT status. The narrow theme is identifying the objects involved in writing and posting a physical letter, including the letter itself. It does not test writing a letter, postal procedures, grammar, or general office vocabulary.
groups.prerequisiteRationale: Basic kana recognition supports the display readings; no lesson ownership or grammar prerequisite is imposed by this draft.
groups.masteryScopeNote: Coverage concerns all six member items. Repetition of one item does not establish breadth; VOC-02 group evidence uses a per-item window and includes unanswered members in the denominator.
